title: Closing and Reopening a Harborline Account
content:
# Closing and reopening an account

> Harborline Customer Accounts

## Conditions of closure

An account may be closed only when every domain holding of the customer is deleted, transferred out or cancelled. An account may be closed only when every hosting plan of the customer is cancelled or terminated. An account may be closed only when every certificate subscription of the customer is expired, revoked or cancelled. An account may be closed only when every email subscription of the customer is cancelled. An account may be closed only when every server of the customer is cancelled or terminated. An account may be closed only when every website security plan of the customer is cancelled, as the requirement of no live holdings requires for every product. The statuses are read from the customer's holdings in each product. Closing the account is the holder's own decision.

## At closure and afterwards

At closure the unused deposited credit is returned to the original payment methods where the tier returns deposit credit at closure, and refund, service and goodwill credit is forfeited. A closed account is reopened at the holder's request, and may be reopened only on or before the closure date plus the reopening window in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the closure date, counting the day after closure as day 1, and the last day is included. A new sign-up must confirm its verification email within the verification link hours of the link being sent, and an account still unverified the purge days after sign-up is purged.

| Tier | No live holdings required for closure | Reopening window (calendar days after closure) | Unused deposited credit returned at closure | Unverified account purged after (calendar days) | Verification link valid (elapsed hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | Yes (true) | 30 | Yes (true) | 30 | 48 |
| Harborline Business Account | Yes (true) | 30 | Yes (true) | 30 | 48 |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | Yes (true) | 30 | Yes (true) | 30 | 48 |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | Yes (true) | 30 | Yes (true) | 30 | 48 |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | Yes (true) | 30 | Yes (true) | 30 | 48 |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | Yes (true) | 30 | Yes (true) | 30 | 48 |

## Holdings that permit closure

| Product holding | Statuses that permit closure |
|---|---|
| Domain holding | deleted, transferred out, cancelled |
| Hosting plan | cancelled, terminated |
| Certificate subscription | expired, revoked, cancelled |
| Email subscription | cancelled |
| Server | cancelled, terminated |
| Website security plan | cancelled |

## Reopening boundary (hypothetical dates)

An account is closed on 10 June. Day 1 is 11 June and day 30 is 10 July. A reopening on 10 July is inside the window; on 11 July it is outside.
